page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.hfg6 family. It is configured with 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs, running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The processor is an Intel Xeon 8269CY with a 35 MB L3 cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 KB L1d cache. The instance features 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark results place this instance in the average performance tier across multiple workloads. In CPU-focused tests, the server achieved a stress-ng single-core score of 1436.68 and a multi-core score of 30666.35, alongside a PassMark CPU score of 29517.51. Memory bandwidth tests show 1705.41 GB/sec for cached small-block reads, dropping to 109.89 GB/sec for large-block reads and 48.22 GB/sec for large-block writes. For specialized tasks, the instance completed bzip3 multi-threaded decompression at 140.98 GB/sec and registered a Geekbench software compilation score of 23704.0.

With its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-core ratio, the ecs.hfg6.8xlarge is designed for workloads requiring consistent compute performance without burst degradation. It is suitable for database operations, which scored 11442.59 on PassMark, and Redis deployments, where it achieved 28.91 million SET operations per second. The instance also supports light machine learning tasks, processing 135M parameter LLM prompts at 1539.55 tokens per second and 7B parameter prompts at 45.98 tokens per second. The lack of local storage and GPUs makes it a cost-efficient option for compute-heavy, network-reliant tasks rather than storage-intensive or deep learning workloads.
